svg.title: A symmetry supplies an energy comparison
svg.desc: Repeated geometric slices are connected by a time-translation vector, next to the conserved pairing minus p dot xi. The drawing is schematic. A timelike Killing vector provides a stationary energy; normalization and the observer’s local energy measurement must still be specified.

g.text: 23 / A SYMMETRY SUPPLIES AN ENERGY COMPARISON
The geometry repeats under a shift in time.
A direction along which the metric is unchanged.
Then no automatic conserved energy of this form.
